scenes.text: An L L M on its own can only write text. [1] It can't check today's weather, or book you a cab. [2] Unless we give it tools.
Tool use, also called function calling, [1] means the AI can ask your app to run a function, and then use the result. [2] Get live data. [3] Calculate exactly. [4] Take actions.

data.definition: The AI asks your app to run a function, then uses the result in its answer.

scenes.text: Watch. [1] You ask, should I carry an umbrella in Hyderabad today? [2] The model doesn't guess. It writes a tool call. Get weather, city Hyderabad. [3] Your app calls the weather service, and gets back, rain, eighty percent. [4] And the model answers. Yes, carry an umbrella, there's an eighty percent chance of rain.

data.heading: Function calling, live
data.question: Should I carry an umbrella in Hyderabad today?
data.answer: Yes! There's an 80% chance of rain in Hyderabad today. Carry an umbrella.

scenes.text: Important. [1] The AI never runs the tool itself. It only asks. [2] Your app decides whether to run it, and runs it. [3] Then the result goes back to the AI. That keeps you in control.

data.heading: Who does what
steps: AI turns it into an answer

scenes.text: It's already everywhere. [1] Assistants that add events to your calendar. [2] Travel apps that check flight prices live. [3] Support bots that look up your order status.
Myth! [1] The AI is directly logged into your apps. [2] No. It can only request tools that a developer gave it. The app does the actual work, and should ask you before anything important.

data.myth: The AI is directly logged into my apps.
data.fact: It can only request tools a developer gave it. The app does the work, and should confirm big actions.

scenes.text: Quick quiz! In function calling, who actually runs the function? [1] Pause and think. <pause 3.2> [2] Your app does! The AI only asks. Comment app if you got it!

Recap. [1] Tools let AI use live data, and take actions. [2] The AI only asks. [3] Your app runs the tool. [4] The result comes back as a helpful answer. [5] Next episode, AI agents. When AI plans and uses tools on its own, step by step. Follow AI Maastaaru!
